title: Ticking Part sales while See Financial Data is OFF asks you to turn See Financial Data on
custom_preconds: 1. Open Create Role (or edit a custom role) with See Financial Data OFF and the Parts Department card expanded.
custom_steps:
1. Tick the Part sales View box.
  2. Tick the Part sales Create & Edit box.
custom_expected:
A dialog titled 'Enable See Financial Data?' appears, with Cancel and Enable buttons.

The dialog explains that Part sales needs See Financial Data.

Choosing Enable turns See Financial Data on and keeps the box ticked; choosing Cancel unticks the box.
evidence: Modal 'Enable See Financial Data?' (Cancel/Enable) confirmed in build (FinancialDataConfirmModal). Tick behavior needs the role editor driven live (headless-unreachable per prior run).
